# GIRP

> > GIRP (European Healthcare Distribution Association) represents pharmaceutical wholesale distributors across Europe, coordinating policy and advocacy from Brussels.

GIRP serves as the voice of pharmaceutical distribution in Europe, engaging with EU institutions, healthcare stakeholders, and medicines verification systems like EMVO. The organization focuses on ensuring efficient and secure pharmaceutical supply chains across European markets.
